title: Blog post outline
description: Turn a topic into a structured outline with H2s, angle, and proof needs.
body: Act as a senior content editor. Create a blog outline for {{topic}} aimed at {{audience}}. Include a working title, a one-sentence thesis, 5–8 H2 sections with 2–3 bullet points each, where to place examples or data, and a closing CTA of type {{cta_type}}. Do not invent statistics; mark missing facts as [NEEDS SOURCE].

title: Thought leadership draft
description: Draft an opinionated industry piece with clear stance and counterpoints.
body: Act as a {{role}} writing thought leadership for {{publication_or_channel}}. Stance: {{stance}}. Audience: {{audience}}. Write a 700–1000 word draft with a sharp opening, 3 supporting arguments, 1 honest counterpoint, and a practical close. Use only the provided facts: {{facts}}. Use [PLACEHOLDER] for unknowns. Avoid buzzword stacking.

title: Customer case study narrative
description: Structure a case study without fabricating metrics.
body: Act as a B2B content strategist. Draft a case study about {{customer_type}} using {{product_or_service}}. Problem: {{problem}}. Approach: {{approach}}. Results (use only these): {{results}}. Sections: situation, challenge, solution, implementation, outcomes, lessons. If a metric is missing, write [METRIC NEEDED]. Tone: {{tone}}.

title: Weekly newsletter issue
description: Scannable newsletter with sections and one primary CTA.
body: Act as a newsletter editor for {{brand}}. Audience: {{audience}}. Theme: {{theme}}. Notes: {{notes}}. Produce 3 subject lines, preview text, intro (≤80 words), 3 section blurbs with [LINK], and primary CTA: {{cta}}. Voice: {{voice}}.

title: FAQ page from product notes
description: FAQ pairs from messy notes with uncertainty labels.
body: Act as a technical writer. Build an FAQ for {{product}} from notes: {{notes}}. Audience: {{audience}}. Produce 8–12 Q&A pairs grouped by theme. Flag uncertain answers as [CONFIRM WITH TEAM]. Do not invent pricing or SLAs.

title: Whitepaper content brief
description: Research-backed whitepaper brief with evidence plan.
body: Act as a content strategist. Whitepaper brief on {{topic}} for {{audience}}. Goal: {{goal}}. Include title options, thesis, length, H1/H2 outline, evidence types, interview roles, distribution, success metrics. Constraints: {{constraints}}.

title: Clarity rewrite
description: Rewrite dense copy for clarity without new claims.
body: Act as a clarity editor. Rewrite for {{audience}} at about grade {{reading_level}}. Preserve factual claims; flag ambiguities as [CLARIFY]. Original: {{original_text}}. Tone: {{tone}}.

title: Podcast show notes
description: Show notes with chapters and quotes from notes only.
body: Act as a podcast producer. Show notes for {{episode_topic}} featuring {{guest}}. Notes: {{notes}}. Include title options, 100-word summary, chapter markers ([MM:SS] if unknown), pull quotes only if present, resources. Audience: {{audience}}.

title: Landing page hero copy
description: Hero headline, subhead, and CTA variants.
body: Act as a conversion copywriter. Hero copy for {{product}} sold to {{audience}}. Benefit: {{benefit}}. Proof: {{proof}}. Produce 5 headlines, 3 subheads, 3 primary CTAs, 1 secondary CTA. Avoid hype. Mark legal-sensitive claims [LEGAL REVIEW].

title: Value proposition block
description: Convert pains and gains into a crisp value prop.
body: Act as a product marketer. Product: {{product}}. Audience: {{audience}}. Pains: {{pains}}. Gains: {{gains}}. Alternative: {{alternative}}. Features allowed: {{features}}. Write one-sentence value prop, 3 pillars, and differentiation vs the alternative. Do not invent features.

title: Paid ad variants
description: Ad variants with hooks and CTAs.
body: Act as a performance copywriter. Create {{variant_count}} ad variants for {{offer}} targeting {{audience}}. Constraints: {{platform_constraints}}. Angle: {{angle}}. Each: hook, body ≤ {{max_words}} words, CTA. Forbidden claims: {{forbidden_claims}}.

title: Tagline system
description: Taglines across functional, emotional, and contrarian tones.
body: Act as a brand copywriter. Tagline system for {{brand}} in {{category_space}}. Promise: {{promise}}. Personality: {{personality}}. Produce 8 taglines with one-line rationales. Avoid: {{cliches_to_avoid}}.

title: Feature-to-benefit translation
body: Act as a product marketer. Translate features into benefit bullets for {{audience}}. Product: {{product}}. Features: {{features}}. Context: {{context}}. For each: benefit, when it matters, suggested proof type.

title: Pricing page copy
body: Act as a SaaS copywriter. Pricing page for {{product}}. Plans: {{plans}}. Audience: {{audience}}. Differentiation: {{differentiation}}. Write plan blurbs, who each plan is for, FAQ (6), objection handlers. Use [PRICE] tokens only. Compliance: {{compliance_notes}}.

title: Empty-state microcopy
description: Helpful empty states with next action.
body: Act as a UX writer. Empty state for {{screen_name}} in {{product}}. Goal: {{user_goal}}. Primary action: {{primary_action}}. Constraints: {{constraints}}. Provide title, body ≤40 words, button label, optional secondary link. Tone: {{tone}}.

title: Copy A/B test hypotheses
body: Act as a CRO specialist. Element: {{element}}. Audience: {{audience}}. Current copy: {{current_copy}}. Metric: {{metric}}. Propose 5 A/B hypotheses with change, rationale, risk, and measurement. No guaranteed uplift claims.

title: Product launch email sequence
description: Three-email launch sequence with subjects and CTAs.
body: Act as a lifecycle marketer. 3-email launch sequence for {{product}} to {{audience}}. Benefit: {{benefit}}. Proof: {{proof}}. CTA: {{cta}}. For each email: goal, 3 subjects, preview, body, CTA, day offset. No invented discounts. Constraints: {{constraints}}.

title: Onboarding drip emails
body: Act as a customer education email writer. {{day_count}}-day onboarding drip for {{product}}. Activation: {{activation_milestone}}. Audience: {{audience}}. Facts: {{product_facts}}. Each email: trigger, subject, body, single CTA, success signal.

title: Re-engagement email
body: Act as a retention marketer. Re-engage {{product}} users inactive {{inactive_period}}. Reasons: {{reasons}}. Value reminder: {{value_reminder}}. Offer: {{offer}}. 4 subjects + body. Unsubscribe-friendly. No guilt.

title: Sales follow-up after demo
body: Act as an AE. Post-demo follow-up to {{prospect_name}} at {{company}}. Pain: {{pain}}. Highlights: {{highlights}}. Open questions: {{open_questions}}. Next step: {{next_step}}. Concise email + 3 subjects. No fake urgency.

title: Customer success check-in
description: Check-in email with agenda and outcomes.
body: Act as a CSM. Check-in to {{contact_name}} at {{account}}. Adoption: {{adoption_snapshot}}. Goals: {{goals}}. Risks: {{risks}}. Propose {{duration}}-minute agenda with 3 outcomes. Tone: {{tone}}.

title: Incident status email
description: Incident email with impact and next update.
body: Act as incident communications. Email about {{incident_name}}. Impact: {{impact}}. Status: {{status}}. Known: {{known}}. Actions: {{actions}}. Next update: {{next_update}}. Audience: {{audience}}. No blame or speculation.

title: Partnership outreach email
body: Act as BD. Outreach to {{partner_name}} about collaborating with {{our_company}}. Mutual value: {{mutual_value}}. Proof: {{proof}}. Ask: {{ask}}. ≤150 words. 3 subjects.

title: Internal product announcement
body: Act as internal comms. Announce {{feature_or_change}} at {{company}}. Why: {{why}}. Customer impact: {{customer_impact}}. Employee actions: {{actions}}. FAQ (5) + talking points. Tone: {{tone}}.

title: SEO content brief
description: SEO brief from keyword and intent.
body: Act as an SEO strategist. Keyword: {{primary_keyword}}. Intent: {{intent}}. Audience: {{audience}}. Competitors: {{competitors}}. Brief: title options, meta description, intent notes, outline, internal link opportunities as [URL NEEDED], FAQs, differentiation. Locale: {{locale}}.

title: Title and meta batch
description: Title tags and meta descriptions in length budgets.
body: Act as SEO copywriter. For each page in {{page_list}}, write 1 title (≤60 chars target) and 1 meta (≤155 chars). Brand: {{brand}}. Tone: {{tone}}.

title: SERP-informed outline
description: Outline covering SERP themes and gaps.
body: Act as SEO editor. Query: {{query}}. SERP themes: {{serp_themes}}. Gaps: {{gaps}}. Audience: {{audience}}. Outline covering necessary themes, unique gap sections, E-E-A-T signals. Word range: {{word_range}}.

title: Internal linking plan
body: Act as SEO architect. New topic: {{topic}}. Site sections: {{site_sections}}. Existing pages: {{existing_pages}}. Propose 8–12 internal links with anchors and direction. Avoid over-optimized exact match.

title: Product page SEO copy
body: Act as ecommerce SEO copywriter. Product: {{product}}. Category: {{category_name}}. Attributes: {{attributes}}. JTBD: {{jtbd}}. Primary term: {{primary_term}}. Secondary: {{secondary_terms}}. Write H1, intro, specs narrative, use-cases, FAQ (6). No invented certifications.

title: Local SEO landing page
description: Local service page with NAP placeholders.
body: Act as local SEO copywriter. Service: {{service}} in {{city_region}}. Business: {{business_name}}. Differentiators: {{differentiators}}. Service area: {{service_area}}. Write H1, intro, services, why-us, process, FAQ. Use [ADDRESS], [PHONE], [HOURS]. No fake reviews.

title: Content refresh plan
body: Act as SEO content lead. Topic: {{topic}}. Issues: {{issues}}. Performance notes: {{performance_notes}}. Plan: keep/cut/expand, new FAQs, freshness signals, internal links, republish checklist. Do not invent ranking data.

title: Structured data suggestions
body: Act as technical SEO. Page type: {{page_type}}. Summary: {{content_summary}}. Site: {{site_name}}. Suggest schema.org types, properties, JSON-LD skeleton with placeholders, and invalid markup risks.

title: Launch announcement thread
description: Multi-post launch thread with proof and CTA.
body: Act as a social strategist. {{platform}} thread announcing {{product_or_feature}} for {{audience}}. Proof: {{proof}}. CTA: {{cta}}. {{post_count}} posts. Tone: {{tone}}. No fake social proof.

title: LinkedIn thought post
body: Act as LinkedIn ghostwriter for a {{persona}}. Insight: {{insight}}. Audience: {{audience}}. Strong first line, short paragraphs, one takeaway, soft CTA. Max 3 hashtags related to {{topic}}. No engagement bait.

title: Two-week social calendar
body: Act as social planner. Brand: {{brand}}. Pillars: {{pillars}}. Platforms: {{platforms}}. Goal: {{goal}}. 14-day calendar: date, platform, pillar, format, angle, CTA. Include 2 experiments. Constraints: {{constraints}}.

title: Community reply pack
body: Act as community manager for {{product}}. Question theme: {{question_cluster}}. Facts: {{facts}}. Write 5 reply variants (brief, detailed, playful, formal, docs redirect). Never invent policy.

title: Short-form video script
body: Act as short-form video writer. Product: {{product}}. Hook: {{hook}}. Demo: {{demo_point}}. CTA: {{cta}}. {{duration_seconds}}s script with on-screen text, spoken lines, shot notes. Platform: {{platform}}. Audience: {{audience}}.

title: Social crisis holding statement
description: Holding statement during an unfolding issue.
body: Act as crisis communications. Issue: {{issue}}. Facts: {{facts}}. Unknowns: {{unknowns}}. Holding statement for {{platforms}} under {{max_chars}} chars if possible, plus longer follow-up template. Empathy first; no speculation.

title: UGC creator brief
description: Creator brief with brand safety rules.
body: Act as creator marketing manager. Product: {{product}}. Goal: {{goal}}. Audience: {{audience}}. UGC brief: concept, hooks, must-say, must-not-say, length, deliverables, brand safety. Claims only from: {{approved_claims}}.

title: Poll and engagement prompts
body: Act as community strategist for {{brand}}. Theme: {{theme}}. Audience: {{audience}}. Create 5 polls with options, why each matters, and brand follow-up prompt. Avoid: {{avoid_topics}}.

title: User interview guide
description: Discussion guide with warm-up and probes.
body: Act as UX researcher. Goal: {{study_goal}}. Participants: {{participants}}. Hypotheses: {{hypotheses}}. 45-minute guide: consent, warm-up, core questions, probes, tasks, wrap-up. Avoid leading questions. Constraints: {{constraints}}.

title: Qual research synthesis
description: Themes with evidence separated from interpretation.
body: Act as research synthesizer. Question: {{research_question}}. Notes: {{notes}}. Produce themes, evidence, contradictions, opportunities, open questions. Keep interpretation separate. Stakeholder: {{stakeholder}}.

title: Competitor teardown
body: Act as competitive analyst. Competitor: {{competitor}}. Category: {{category_name}}. Our product: {{our_product}}. Facts: {{facts}}. Teardown: positioning, ICP clues, strengths, weaknesses, pricing signals if known, UX notes, implications. Mark [UNKNOWN].

title: Survey questionnaire design
description: Unbiased survey mapped to a decision.
body: Act as survey methodologist. Decision: {{decision}}. Audience: {{audience}}. Constraints: {{constraints}}. Design survey sections, types, scales, logic, screening, bias checks. Max questions: {{max_questions}}.

title: Lightweight literature brief
body: Act as research analyst. Question: {{question}}. Sources (only these): {{sources}}. Brief: findings, agreements, disagreements, caveats, gaps. Cite by provided labels. No external facts.

title: Journey map from notes
body: Act as service designer. Persona: {{persona}}. Scenario: {{scenario}}. Notes: {{notes}}. Stages with actions, thoughts, emotions, pains, opportunities. Label low-confidence inferences. Goal: {{goal}}.

title: Experiment design brief
body: Act as product analyst. Idea: {{idea}}. Problem: {{problem}}. Design: hypothesis, primary metric, guardrails, segments, duration guidance, sample-size caveats, rollout. Success: {{success_definition}}. Risks: {{risks}}.

title: Stakeholder discovery interview
body: Act as discovery facilitator. Initiative: {{initiative}}. Role: {{role}}. 30-minute script: goals, constraints, metrics, risks, open decisions + note template. Context: {{context}}.

title: Discovery call script
body: Act as enterprise AE coach. Product: {{product}}. ICP: {{icp}}. Discovery plan: opener, situation, problem, impact, decision-process questions, next-step close. No manipulative tactics. Context: {{deal_context}}.

title: Outbound email sequence
body: Act as an SDR. Offer: {{offer}}. ICP: {{icp}}. Pain: {{pain}}. Proof: {{proof}}. Write a {{touch_count}}-touch outbound email sequence. Each touch: goal, subject, body ≤120 words, personalization slots marked with double curly braces around field names. Soft CTA. Compliance: {{compliance}}.

title: Proposal narrative
body: Act as solutions consultant. Prospect: {{prospect}}. Problem: {{problem}}. Solution: {{solution}}. Scope: {{scope}}. Timeline: {{timeline}}. Pricing approach: {{pricing_approach}}. Narrative: executive summary, approach, outcomes, risks/mitigations, next steps. No invented ROI.

title: Objection handling pack
body: Act as sales enablement. Product: {{product}}. Objections: {{objections}}. Proof points: {{proof_points}}. For each: clarify question, response, story cue, when to loop SE. Consultative tone.

title: Strategic account plan
body: Act as strategic account lead. Account: {{account}}. ARR context: {{arr_context}}. Stakeholders: {{stakeholders}}. Goals: {{goals}}. Competitors: {{competitors}}. Plan: whitespace, risks, multi-thread map, 90-day plays, mutual success milestones.

title: Demo storyboard
description: Outcome-led demo flow with skip rules.
body: Act as sales engineer. Pain: {{pain}}. Persona: {{persona}}. Capabilities allowed: {{capabilities}}. {{minutes}}-minute storyboard: scenes, talk track, clicks, proof, skip rules. Next step: {{next_step}}.

title: ROI discovery questionnaire
description: Questions for a credible value model.
body: Act as value engineer. Product: {{product}}. Value drivers: {{value_drivers}}. Industry: {{industry}}. Questionnaire for ROI model: baselines, status-quo cost, adoption assumptions, risks. Formulas as placeholders only.

title: Champion enablement one-pager
body: Act as sales partner to a champion. Champion role: {{champion_role}}. Economic buyer: {{economic_buyer}}. Problem: {{problem}}. Solution: {{solution}}. One-pager: problem cost, approach, risks, ask, FAQ. Facts only: {{approved_facts}}.

title: Support reply (general)
body: Act as support specialist. Issue: {{issue}}. Known facts: {{known_facts}}. Policy: {{policy}}. Reply: acknowledge impact, state knowns, next steps, follow-up expectation. Tone: {{tone}}. No promises beyond policy.

title: Bug report triage response
description: Customer repro ask + internal triage note.
body: Act as L2 support. Bug: {{bug_summary}}. Environment: {{environment}}. Product: {{product}}. Customer reply requesting missing repro details + internal engineering triage note with provisional severity.

title: Support macro set
description: Reusable macros for a topic cluster.
body: Act as support ops. Topic: {{topic}}. Product: {{product}}. Steps: {{steps}}. Create 5 macros: acknowledge, gather info, workaround, resolved, escalate. Keep variable slots as named placeholders in plain language. Tone: {{tone}}.

title: Escalation summary
body: Act as support lead. Customer: {{customer}}. Impact: {{impact}}. Timeline: {{timeline}}. Troubleshooting: {{troubleshooting}}. Ask: {{ask}}. Write escalation ticket with severity rationale and comms status.

title: Billing exception reply
body: Act as billing support. Request: {{request}}. Policy: {{policy}}. Account facts: {{account_facts}}. Locale: {{locale}}. Explain policy, options, next steps. If exception needs manager approval, say [MANAGER APPROVAL].

title: How-to help article
description: Step-by-step help article from UI notes.
body: Act as KB author. Task: {{task}}. Product: {{product}}. UI notes: {{ui_notes}}. Audience: {{audience}}. Article: title, intro, prerequisites, numbered steps, expected result, troubleshooting. Uncertain labels: [CONFIRM UI].

title: Ticket status update
body: Act as support. Context: {{context}}. Progress: {{progress}}. Blockers: {{blockers}}. Next action: {{next_action}}. Short proactive update. Tone: {{tone}}.

title: KB draft from ticket patterns
description: Draft KB from repeated ticket themes.
body: Act as support content lead. Theme: {{theme}}. Snippets: {{snippets}}. Known fix: {{known_fix}}. Product: {{product}}. Draft public KB + shorter macro. Flag conflicting guidance.

title: Focused code review
description: Review for correctness, tests, and risk.
body: Act as code reviewer for {{language_or_stack}}. Summary: {{change_summary}}. Diff/description: {{diff}}. Identify correctness risks, missing tests, security/privacy, performance, smallest follow-ups. Severity-tag findings. No unrelated rewrites.

title: Technical design doc skeleton
description: Design doc structure for a system change.
body: Act as staff engineer. Problem: {{problem}}. Goals: {{goals}}. Non-goals: {{non_goals}}. Constraints: {{constraints}}. Stack: {{stack}}. Draft: context, options, proposed design, data model, APIs, failure modes, rollout, observability, open questions.

title: Bug reproduction plan
description: Repro steps and hypotheses from a vague report.
body: Act as debugging partner. Report: {{bug_report}}. System: {{system}}. Produce minimal repro, expected vs actual, environment matrix, ordered hypotheses, instrumentation. Do not invent stack traces.

title: Test plan for a feature
body: Act as QA-minded engineer. Feature: {{feature}}. Acceptance: {{acceptance_criteria}}. Risks: {{risks}}. Stack: {{stack}}. Test plan: unit, integration, edge, negative, regression; automated vs manual.

title: REST API shape proposal
body: Act as API designer. Domain: {{domain}}. Use cases: {{use_cases}}. Constraints: {{constraints}}. Compatibility: {{compatibility}}. Propose resources, endpoints, sketches, idempotency, authz, errors. Prefer boring REST.

title: Safe refactor plan
body: Act as refactoring specialist. Area: {{area}}. Problem: {{problem}}. Constraints: {{constraints}}. Incremental plan with green intermediate states, tests-first steps, rollback notes. No big-bang rewrite.

title: Incident postmortem draft
body: Act as SRE. Incident: {{incident}}. Timeline: {{timeline}}. Impact: {{impact}}. Factors: {{factors}}. Draft blameless postmortem: summary, timeline, contributing factors, goods/bads, action items with [OWNER].

title: Spec-to-implementation prompt
description: Tight implementation prompt for a coding agent.
body: Act as eng lead briefing a coding agent. Feature: {{feature}}. Conventions: {{conventions}}. Files: {{files}}. Acceptance: {{acceptance}}. Stack: {{stack}}. Single implementation prompt with scope fences, non-goals, definition of done.

title: PRD draft
body: Act as PM. Problem: {{problem}}. Users: {{users}}. Goals: {{goals}}. Constraints: {{constraints}}. PRD: context, problem, goals/non-goals, stories, MoSCoW requirements, metrics, risks, open questions. No invented market sizes.

title: Decision memo
body: Act as PM. Decision: {{decision}}. Context: {{context}}. Options: {{options}}. Memo for {{audience}}: recommendation, tradeoffs, risks, reversibility, assumptions to verify by {{deadline}}.

title: Roadmap narrative
body: Act as product leader. Horizon: {{horizon}}. Themes: {{themes}}. Commitments vs bets: {{commitments_vs_bets}}. Audience: {{audience}}. Narrative: vision link, themes, sequencing, non-goals, progress measures.

title: User story map slice
body: Act as PM. Journey: {{journey}}. Persona: {{persona}}. Activities: {{activities}}. Product: {{product}}. MVP stories with acceptance criteria, later slices, dependencies.

title: Product metrics spec
body: Act as product analyst partner. Area: {{area}}. Outcome: {{outcome}}. Existing data: {{existing_data}}. Propose north-star candidate, inputs, guardrails, events, dashboard questions. Avoid vanity metrics.

title: Feature launch checklist
body: Act as product ops. Feature: {{feature}}. Launch type: {{launch_type}}. Risks: {{risks}}. Checklist across eng, design, docs, support, marketing, sales, legal, analytics + go/no-go criteria.

title: Positioning against competitor
description: When we win / lose talk tracks.
body: Act as product marketer with PM. Product: {{product}}. Competitor: {{competitor}}. Win themes: {{win_themes}}. Loss themes: {{loss_themes}}. Facts: {{facts}}. Positioning: when we win/lose, talk tracks, landmines.

title: Team retrospective facilitator
body: Act as agile facilitator. Team: {{team}}. Period: {{period}}. Events: {{events}}. 60-minute retro: agenda, prompts, input methods, action-item template. Blameless.

title: Lesson plan
description: Timed lesson with checks for understanding.
body: Act as instructional designer. Topic: {{topic}}. Learners: {{learners}}. Duration: {{duration}}. Lesson plan: measurable objectives, materials, timed agenda, activities, CFU, homework. A11y: {{a11y_notes}}.

title: Explain like I'm learning
body: Act as a patient tutor. Concept: {{concept}}. Level: {{level}}. Context: {{context}}. Explain plainly, then analogy, then deeper pass, then one practice Q&A. Define jargon.

title: Quiz generator
body: Act as assessment designer. Topic: {{topic}}. Objectives: {{objectives}}. {{question_count}} questions (MCQ + short answer), answer key, short rubrics. Difficulty mix: {{difficulty_mix}}. No trick questions.

title: Course outline
body: Act as curriculum designer. Course: {{course_name}}. Audience: {{audience}}. Outcome: {{outcome}}. Duration: {{duration}}. Prerequisites: {{prerequisites}}. Modules with outcomes, lessons, practice, capstone brief.

title: Assignment feedback rubric
body: Act as TA lead. Assignment: {{assignment}}. Criteria: {{criteria}}. Learners: {{learners}}. 4-level rubric + feedback comment bank (strength + improvement) per criterion.

title: Personal study plan
description: Time-boxed study plan to a goal.
body: Act as learning coach. Goal: {{goal}}. Level: {{level}}. Hours/week: {{hours_per_week}}. Deadline: {{deadline}}. Resources: {{resources}}. Week-by-week plan with milestones and progress checks.

title: Socratic tutoring prompt
body: Act as Socratic tutor for {{subject}}. Question: {{question}}. Level: {{level}}. Plan a dialogue tree of guiding questions then a concise answer check. Hint policy: {{hint_policy}}. Never shame mistakes.

title: Workshop agenda
body: Act as workshop facilitator. Topic: {{topic}}. Participants: {{participants}}. Duration: {{duration}}. Outcomes: {{outcomes}}. Hybrid constraints: {{hybrid_constraints}}. Timed agenda, activities, materials, facilitator notes.

title: EDA plan
description: Exploratory analysis plan for a dataset.
body: Act as data analyst. Question: {{business_question}}. Dataset: {{dataset}}. Tools: {{tools}}. EDA plan: quality checks, uni/bivariate views, segments, anomalies, deliverables, assumptions.

title: SQL analysis request
description: Business question to SQL with assumptions.
body: Act as analytics engineer. Question: {{question}}. Schema: {{schema}}. Dialect: {{dialect}}. Write commented SQL + assumptions + validation queries. Missing columns as [NEED COLUMN].

title: Dashboard specification
body: Act as BI lead. Audience: {{audience}}. Decisions: {{decisions}}. Metrics: {{metrics}}. Tool: {{tool}}. Dashboard spec: pages, charts, filters, definitions, refresh, access. Avoid chartjunk.

title: A/B test analysis outline
body: Act as experiment analyst. Experiment: {{experiment}}. Primary: {{primary_metric}}. Guardrails: {{guardrails}}. Data notes: {{data_notes}}. Outline checks, segments, multiple-comparison caution, decision framework. No fabricated statistics.

title: Metric definition sheet
body: Act as analytics governance. Metric: {{metric_name}}. Intent: {{intent}}. Sources: {{sources}}. Definition: formula, grain, window, filters, caveats, owner [OWNER], related metrics.

title: Metric anomaly investigation
body: Act as data detective. Metric: {{metric}}. Change: {{change}}. Range: {{time_range}}. Context: {{context}}. Plan: data quality, cuts, external factors, root-cause classes, status update template.

title: Cohort analysis brief
body: Act as growth analyst. Product: {{product}}. Behavior: {{behavior}}. Limits: {{limits}}. Brief: cohort definition options, windows, metrics, viz recommendations, pitfalls.

title: Analytics exec summary
description: Turn analysis notes into exec summary.
body: Act as analytics translator. Notes: {{notes}}. Decision: {{decision}}. Audience: {{audience}}. One-page summary: headline findings, evidence, uncertainties, recommended actions. No new analyses.

title: Prompt quality rubric
description: Score a prompt on structure and constraints.
body: Act as prompt quality reviewer. Evaluate for {{target_model_family}}. Prompt: {{prompt_text}}. Domain: {{domain}}. Score 1–5 on goal clarity, context, constraints, output format, evaluability. Reasons + rewrites for scores under 4.

title: Prompt regression case set
description: Golden set of inputs and expected traits.
body: Act as LLM eval engineer. Purpose: {{purpose}}. Failure modes: {{failure_modes}}. Design {{case_count}} cases with input, expected properties, severity. Include edge and policy-safe adversarial-lite cases.

title: Compare two prompts
description: Criteria-based comparison of prompt A vs B.
body: Act as prompt evaluator. Task: {{task}}. Prompt A: {{prompt_a}}. Prompt B: {{prompt_b}}. Outputs: {{outputs}}. Compare correctness, specificity, safety, verbosity/cost, robustness. Recommend winner or hybrid. Do not favor length alone.

title: Prompt red-team checklist
description: Defensive stress tests for injection and leakage.
body: Act as defensive LLM safety analyst. Purpose: {{purpose}}. Data classes: {{data_classes}}. Constraints: {{constraints}}. Checklist: injection simulations (described, not exploit kits), secret leakage checks, over-refusal risks, logging concerns, mitigations.
